parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description:
The code for the multicloud environment. Valid values:

- qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

- hcloud: Huawei Cloud.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data source. The threat analysis feature generates this ID by calculating an MD5 hash of the parameters.
Call the [DescribeDataSourceInstance](~~2639736~~) operation to obtain the data source ID.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceLogs
parameters.description: The details of the data source parameters, in a JSON array format.

parameters.name: DataSourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS).

- wafApi: Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF) download API.

- ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka.

parameters.name: LogInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the log. The threat analysis feature generates this ID by calculating an MD5 hash of the parameters. Call the [ListDataSourceLogs](~~2639707~~) operation to obtain the log ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management hub is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China.
